title: Changes from Vanilla
description:
This pack changes quite of few of Vanilla's mechanics. Many of those changes are described in other chapters of this guide. Here are some changes that didn't really fit into any other chapter:

Combat:

There are no swords. Nor bows, crossbows, or arrows. No hostile mobs spawn in this pack (except the Ender Dragon, if you actually pursue The End, or The Wither, should you deliberately summon it, but I do not know where you would get the skulls). Phantoms are disabled. The Warden is disabled. Pillagers/Illagers and their structures have been completely removed.

Villages:

Villages and Villagers too, have been removed. Your economy is powered by the Shipping Bin and the Wandering Trader. Sell with the former to purchase from the latter.

Logging:

Chop trees from the bottom block to fell the whole tree at once.

Convenience Recipes:

* Craft Bones from 3 Bone Meal (in case you would like a farm dog)
* Craft Green Dye from 4 Leaves (helpful for next recipe)
* Craft Slimeballs from Wheat Dough and Lime Dye
* Both Books and Item Frames can be made with Canvas in place of Leather

Enchantments:

Enchantments that are only useful in combat, such as Smite or Sharpness, have been removed. You will not find their books, nor will you roll them on the Enchanting Table. This means a higher chance of rolling utility enchantments, like Unbreaking, Fortune, or Mending. That's right! Mending and Swift Sneak have been added as options to the Enchanting Table.

Mending Bonus: Sneak-right-click while holding a tool enchanted with Mending, to repair it using your stored Experience.
